checks.name: Actual sending tab identified by disabled Waiting for wallet and disabled Cancel
Non-sending tab displays an unresolved wallet intent and denies a valid second draft
Cancelled only the non-sending tab's unsigned confirmation without clearing recovery metadata
Reloaded only the non-sending tab after recording and clearing its known disposable fixture
Unknown-outcome recovery warning and hash-recovery input reappear after page hydration
Re-entered the same valid fixture; Review draft remains disabled for owner B
Original tab remains Waiting for wallet with the exact B signer and zero contract payment

source_and_state_scope: The saved live preflight is hash-bound and its local source pins are checked offline. This browser checkpoint does not claim a fresh chain-state read or final execution for the still-unresolved request. Do not infer nothing was sent merely from the missing hash.
fixture_scope: Cleared only the non-sending tab's exact agent-created fictional question/reply before reload so this recovery test did not depend on an unsaved-draft navigation prompt. Re-entered the same fixture afterward to prove the gate was not merely invalid-input validation. The sending tab's draft and request were not modified. This is not a test of unsaved-draft preservation.
ui_followup: The passive tab kept its old unsigned dialog above the recovery warning until cancelled locally, and described a request held in another tab as WALLET OUTCOME UNKNOWN. Consider clearer cross-tab wording and handling of stale unsigned dialogs during the later UI polish; no app or contract code was changed while a wallet request was held.
limitations: This proves cross-tab UI gating and observer reload persistence while another tab waits for its wallet request.
It does not exercise two simultaneously consented send calls at the Web Locks boundary.
It does not prove exact hidden recovery payload persistence; only the rendered recovery state and later public export/receipt can be bound.
After-signing reload, transaction finalization, exact calldata/output/state, and the expected one-review delta remain unverified until the next human approval.
next_action: Human may review and approve only the existing ReplyCheck MetaMask request from B, not start another review. Observe and preserve any returned hash; do not resend an unknown action.
